It is a high bar for me to post anything positive about old PAC-10 rivals, but loved this!

Here is to seeing the dignity, value, worth, and even divinity in all.

Video

Encourage someone.
Cheer for another.
Celebrate the effort - 
Strides amidst strife; 
Progress and perseverance despite the odds of obstacles. 

We are all journeying toward something - all of us fighting, striving, trying.

And sometimes the greatest gift
is not the finish line…
it’s the voices calling your name along the way.

Lift someone and you rise too.

Video

Donald Trump is not the cause of everything that ails us, we must work together if we want to rise together.

Thanks for having me @profgalloway.

Video

We need to pass this now!

op: nathancjun via IG

Video

Here is to taking a moment to pause and take in the wonder.

Here is to calling time out to breathe in the majesty of a moment.

Here is to defying gravity.

Here is to pushing limits and ascending to new heights.

Here is to the relentless truth of life...

There will always be moments that astonish, that inspire, that remind us: the impossible is only temporary. 🚀

Video

Laying it plain.

Video

May you choose enthusiasm - under any sky.

May you strengthen your will, your defiance, your courage, your compassion- training your spirit for the trials that will come.

And may you never forget:
a life lived boldly doesn’t just change you…
it inspires the world around you.

Video

I’ve said it before — Trump’s illegal, reckless war in Iran is going to leave lasting damage to the global economy. We will all pay for his incompetence while he cashes in.

Video

Cecilia Wang’s argument in front of the Supreme Court lays it plain: President Trump is no match for the 14th Amendment.

Video

A beautiful reminder of the blessings we all share from astronaut Victor Glover.

Video

Happy Easter! May our stories, questions, and spirits continue to inspire us.

Video

Persevere. 
Be kind.

We are all fighting a hard battle.

I will continue to fight in the Senate to stop President Trump's reckless war and start the process of repairing our economy. But make no mistake — the damage he has caused is going to take time to unravel.

More promises broken by this reckless, incompetent administration.

OP: @MSNOWNews

Video

I love the bond of siblings and I’m blessed beyond measure to have two incredible brothers, John and Cary.

But the wisdom passed down to us is this:
family is not meant to be small.

We are called to widen the circle.
To love beyond blood.
To see our neighbors as kin.

I fall short of that calling more often than I’d like.
But especially in hard times, the standard remains.

Because extraordinary moments don’t just demand strength - 
They demand care.
They demand empathy.

How incredible, all across America we gain new patriots every day.

OP: @PackersOutreach

Trump is out of his depth, and Americans are paying the price.
